create_rocbert_tokenizer: create a RoCBert tokenizer instance with vocab, word shape, and pronunciation files for Chinese text tokenization
build_inputs_with_special_tokens: build model inputs from a sequence or pair of sequences by concatenating and adding special tokens like [CLS] and [SEP]
tokenize_text_with_shape_pronunciation: tokenize Chinese text into input ids, shape ids, and pronunciation ids for RoCBert model input
encode_batch_sequences: encode a batch of text sequences into padded and truncated token id arrays with optional tensor output
save_tokenizer_vocabulary: save the RoCBert tokenizer vocabulary, word shape, and pronunciation data to a directory as separate files
